purpose: Reviewable alternative for historical missing observations; not accepted by current v2 trainer or collector.
gates: Review valuation and reward assumptions under missing observations before manuscript changes
Specify acceptance or exclusion limits for long observation gaps using methodological justification; no test-return tuning
Implement and validate partial observations, causal readiness and per-asset order expiration
Freeze strategy-independent eligibility and per-feature training normalizer manifests
Validate finite-depth liquidation, fees, residual positions and stop handling
Reverify PPO A2C SAC DDPG observation dimensions, optimizers and synthetic smoke runs
Retain historical clock and single-venue limitations; no certification of executable liquidity

data.source_delay_interpretation: no established fixed lag; do not subtract three hours

episode.unit: one scheduled regular cash-equity session, portfolio uninterrupted after entry
episode.initial_portfolio: cash only at opening, initial USD 100000; no trading during warmup
episode.grid_reference: minute q from session opening; no pre-open capture carries across opening
episode.entry: first q with all 18 assets valid at q-20 through q, using capture receipt times only
episode.warmup_missing: continue waiting causally; do not search later windows using future coverage
episode.end: original scheduled liquidation minute, independent of entry and future gaps
episode.gap_behavior: keep the same daily clock, cash and inventory; mask unavailable assets, expire affected fills
episode.all_assets_unavailable: advance scheduled time with zero executable orders and held marks; do not infer zero true market return
episode.exit_coverage: all 18 assets have accepted captures received since opening with receipt age <=60 seconds
episode.eligible_coverage: first causal joint warmup with >=2 remaining transitions and common covered scheduled exit; no additional duration exclusion in primary conditional analysis
episode.financial_comparison: common strategy-independent data-eligible dates, retaining stops and liquidation failures
episode.missing_exit: data truncation with inventory preserved; no retroactive sale or complete-day return
episode.short_blocks: rollout boundaries may update learning without resetting portfolio or liquidating

long_gap_policy.choose_using: risk and observation justification with training-only diagnostics; not desired test count
long_gap_policy.cap_unit: consecutive missing one-minute grid points, not exact receipt or market-time age
long_gap_policy.decision_basis: Model incomplete observation explicitly; train-only diagnostics cannot establish a safe duration or bound unseen prices. Do not remove difficult observation paths from the primary estimand.
long_gap_policy.sensitivity_scope: paired summaries of the same frozen policies on predefined common subsets; no retraining or hyperparameter selection
long_gap_policy.two_scenario_design: experimental_scenarios; all-gaps primary rule retained; separately fitted cap-2 secondary scenario

normalization.price: current price / midpoint at most recent earlier valid same-asset grid point - 1, with reference age exposed
normalization.fit: per-market-feature valid observations only from common eligible training dates; unique grid points, exclude masked sentinels
normalization.runtime_fit_gate: scenario-bound historical train normalizers and train-only Gym adapter implemented; final-refit statistics require validation-selected models; synthetic generic APIs stay separate

initialization.exception: SAC conditional log_std head: zero weights and biases, ensuring std=1 for every input
initialization.target_networks: initial exact copies of online networks

SAC.entropy_optimizer: same Adam hyperparameters as actor and critics

training.sampling: uniform common data-eligible daily session with replacement; actual causal entry, continuous portfolio, no intraday reset
training.selection: After exit/learning/account amendment is frozen and verified: require flat closure across every common validation date and tuning seed, then maximize mean net realized cash return; retain all failed candidates in diagnostics.
training.incomplete_seed_set: candidate ineligible; failures reported; no replacement search
training.budget_rounding: at most rollout_steps-1 additional transitions, report actual counts
training.evaluation: deterministic with no online updates; common data-eligible daily dates, explicit missing-data and liquidation-failure reporting

validation_executor.scope: core PPO A2C SAC DDPG in both scenarios; discount/observation variants pending

outcomes.primary: Revised target: realized net cash return for flat-compliant methods on all common dates; marked outcomes with residuals remain diagnostic, without successful-date filtering.
outcomes.aggregation: one outcome per session; equal mean across evaluable sessions and training seeds; daily fixed-capital reset, no compounding
outcomes.primary_contrast: PPO minus equal-allocation single-entry baseline, average across final seeds
secondary: actual entry time and remaining horizon
fraction of marked wealth supported by stale observations
outcomes.residual_positions: keep marked outcome and flag flat-terminal failure
outcomes.unrecoverable_failures: missing explicit outcomes; disclose paired subset; no superiority claim
outcomes.truncations: partial observed duration and marked return separately reported; never a completed session or fictitious liquidation

uncertainty.current_archive_test_reporting: descriptive; session-level paired differences and seed variability

optional_bootstrap.seed_resampling: whole trajectory identifiers, once per replicate

stress.design: one factor at a time, each versus reference, matched baselines

variants.short_intraday_blocks: deferred separately registered secondary study; additional forced exits change the objective
variants.mandatory_availability_fields: retain masks and ages in every observation ablation; never present masked zeros as ordinary market features

planned_fits.status: planning only; historical smoke and diagnostic validation runs completed separately; protocol-budget selection, variants and final refit pending

amendments: Version and justify before reward-based selection; once July policy outcomes are inspected, subsequent amendments make July analysis exploratory.
supersedes: candidate replacement for v2 after review; v2 remains active until approval and implementation

observation_encoder.market_width: 43*N: standardized 40*N fields then N availability masks, N last-receipt ages and N price-reference ages
observation_encoder.trade_rank: descending declared trade time, stable ties; no adjacent-trade returns
observation_encoder.fit_grid: unique valid market features appearing in episode histories from first feature point through exit, common fitting dates only
observation_encoder.runtime_status: historical training integration and core validation executor verified diagnostically; protocol-budget selection, variants and final refit pending

observations.interpretation: partially observed market; feed-forward policy uses explicit masked history and ages
observations.mask: 1 iff accepted current capture since opening and receipt age <=60 seconds; else 0
observations.masked_encoding: 40 numerical values become zero after standardization when mask=0; this is an input sentinel, never zero market prices or sizes
observations.age_encoding: seconds divided by 390*60, clipped to [0,1]; no learned age moments
observations.reference: midpoint at most recent earlier valid same-asset grid point within this session, never future
observations.reference_age: grid time minus reference grid time; zero sentinel if current unavailable; mask distinguishes sentinel
observations.gap_effect: a valid return after a gap may span several minutes; price reference age exposes the elapsed interval
observations.context: cash, N marked exposures, marked wealth / initial capital; elapsed and remaining minutes /390
observations.normalizer_fit: per-market-feature valid observations only from common eligible training dates; unique grid points, exclude masked sentinels
observations.initial_reference: 21 complete readiness points guarantee causal references for the first 20-row window
observations.reference_checkpoint: latest valid same-asset points as of lag_reference; bounded history retains older causal reference and its grid timestamp

orders_with_missing_data.decision: force unavailable asset action components to zero before desired orders and shared-cash budgeting
orders_with_missing_data.fill: intent from q fills only at q+1 if that asset has a currently valid book; otherwise expires
orders_with_missing_data.fees: only actual fills pay fees; per-level execution and participation caps unchanged
orders_with_missing_data.reused_snapshot: consumed displayed depth cannot replenish merely through rereading a cached capture

valuation_reward.mark: update asset midpoint only on current accepted capture; otherwise retain last observed within-session midpoint
valuation_reward.telescoping: sum of rewards equals terminal marked wealth / initial capital - 1
valuation_reward.gap_return: unobserved price changes appear when observations resume; held mark is not a stable-price assertion
valuation_reward.risk_stop: initial-capital floor applies to marked wealth, may detect losses late; latch stop, cancel pending, sell valid assets only
valuation_reward.latched_stop_with_unavailable_holdings: no new buys; retain inventory and try liquidation when books become valid through scheduled exit
valuation_reward.terminal_flat: if flat, terminal marked wealth equals actual simulated cash
valuation_reward.terminal_residual: retain marked residual wealth and disclose failed liquidation; never label as completed flat day-trading return
valuation_reward.primary_reporting: compare terminal marked-wealth score on common eligible dates alongside flat-completion rate, residual exposure and fees
valuation_reward.training_proxy_limitation: reward and capital stop use observed marks rather than contemporaneous unknown market wealth

liquidation.at: scheduled terminal grid point; uses accepted contemporaneously available book only
liquidation.pending_order: terminal interval has no discretionary intention
liquidation.costs_and_capacity: unchanged fee and participation settings; finite depth, no unlimited market fill
liquidation.residual: explicit liquidation failure, inventory retained in result; do not force flatness in accounting
liquidation.next_episode: independent cash-initialized simulated session, not a claim that prior residual holdings were sold

validation_plan: Missing quote does not reset cash, holdings, episode clock or pending orders for other assets
No future observation affects entry, feature reference, masking or order quantity
Missing at scheduled fill expires only affected asset order, without later retroactive execution
Normalization excludes encoded missing-value zeros and validation/test dates
Reference after a gap includes correct interval age; all-observation-missing state remains finite
Reward telescopes with fees and stale marks; negative price jumps appear on observation return
Stop may latch under partial availability and retains unsold inventory
Terminal missing data, insufficient depth and genuine flat completion remain distinct outcomes
All algorithms and baselines use identical causal entry, masks, exit and eligible dates

audit_evidence.status: coverage only; not finalized eligibility or economic feasibility

inherited_settings_review: Models, seeds, search budgets, fees, universe, calendar and partitions retained from v2; baseline applicability and statistical reporting must be checked against the new masks.

baseline_missing_data_rules.cash: same session denominator and clock, always no orders
baseline_missing_data_rules.equal_allocation_single_entry: one intention at actual causal entry, no retries of expired components; common daily exit
baseline_missing_data_rules.ten_interval_momentum_and_reversal: require valid observed endpoints at q and q-10 per asset; otherwise hold that component; never interpolate
baseline_missing_data_rules.uniform_random_actions: same seeds and raw N-action vector, then identical masking and budgeting
baseline_missing_data_rules.all_baselines: same fees, per-level capacity, observed marking, causal entry, daily exit and strategy-independent data eligibility

all_gaps.variants: all planned PPO ablations and discount variants

short_gaps.variants: core algorithms only; no additional ablation fits

experimental_scenarios.short_gap_definition: At most two consecutive unavailable one-minute grid points per asset after causal entry through scheduled exit; not a receipt-age bound or a total missing-data fraction bound.
experimental_scenarios.short_gap_justification: Operational few-step dropout convention at one-minute decision resolution, small relative to the 20-row history. Training diagnostics show one/two-point gaps dominate. Not a safe-loss threshold or chosen using protected policy returns; coverage counts were already known.
experimental_scenarios.independent_fitting: Fit train normalizers and tune each algorithm independently per scenario, with identical grids, seeds, transition budgets and economics; select using that scenario validation dates.
experimental_scenarios.final_refit: After validation selection, fit a new normalizer on that scenario train+validation dates and train final seeds; no test data in fitting.
experimental_scenarios.native_evaluation: Every algorithm and matched baseline on the common eligible test dates inside its own scenario.
experimental_scenarios.cross_scenario_evaluation: Evaluate both scenario-trained frozen model sets and matched baselines on the intersection of eligible test dates, pairing algorithm and training seed; no online updates or extra training.
experimental_scenarios.cross_normalizers: Each checkpoint keeps its own scenario/refit normalizer even on common dates; do not refit normalization on evaluation dates.
experimental_scenarios.interpretation: Common-date comparison removes date-composition differences, but changes training data, normalizers and selected hyperparameters jointly; do not attribute all changes solely to gap duration.
experimental_scenarios.sensitivities: Existing caps 1,2,5,15,30 remain subset-only analyses of all-gaps frozen models. The independently trained short-gaps scenario is distinct from the cap-2 subset sensitivity.
experimental_scenarios.test_reporting: Descriptive paired outcomes and seed variability; no confirmatory secondary superiority claim.

day_trading_review.criterion: Every tuning seed must end all common validation sessions with zero integer holdings and a finite realized cash return; failures remain reported, never remove dates.
day_trading_review.exit_preparation: Specify a causal shared wind-down rule with repeated depth-limited sales; timing and inventory controls require training-only capacity audit, not validation-return optimization.

learning_objective.terminal_adjustment: Subtract marked residual inventory value from the terminal learning reward only; never debit financial cash or remove inventory.
learning_objective.truncation: No terminal inventory adjustment; abort unexpected training truncation.
learning_objective.financial_metrics: Keep marked wealth, holdings, fees and realized-return eligibility unchanged; learning utility is separately reported.
learning_objective.synthetic_verification: 242 regression tests; PPO 384-step smoke; Gym residual cases; historical activation pending account choice.

day_trading_review.account_model: Both modes implemented and configurable via environment.account_regime in immutable protocols; new historical manifests and integration verification pending.

exit_capacity_audit.basis: Maximum finite trailing capacity requirement across independent concentrated-capital training stress cases; not a safe future bound.
exit_capacity_audit.late_entry_policy: Keep common dates; cash only if next execution is already in wind-down phase.
exit_capacity_audit.activation: Explicit wind_down_points=54 in new synthetic replay; immutable historical protocol field episode.wind_down_execution_points controls future bundles. Existing bundles remain at one point.

account_regimes.user_decision: Support both account modes; choose one per frozen campaign.
account_regimes.cash_settled: Purchase costs including fees paid from unspent initial settled funds; sales remain pending and do not replenish intraday buying power.
account_regimes.intraday_buying_power: Net sale proceeds may be reused; no negative economic cash or short holdings; intraday funding/netting access assumed, no extra financing fee modeled.
account_regimes.legacy_mode: legacy_reinvest only for reproducing old artifacts; never implicit for full research selection.
account_regimes.verification: 250 regression tests; eight four-algorithm/two-mode synthetic smokes; 24 flat frozen synthetic evaluations; artifact hashes verified.
